observations: A squat, wide figure fills the center against a flat brown ground; its body is built from layered amber, ochre, and dark brown shapes with black outlines, and jagged black marks spike upward from the top of the head.
Two rectangular forms sit where eyes would be, each outlined in cyan and orange, with white marks inside them; a wide open mouth below shows a row of white teeth against a dark interior.

Loose scribbled lines in yellow, pink, and purple trace the edges of the arms and torso, while a hand raised to the right side of the face is rendered in the same warm brown palette with visible black contour loops.
reading: The figure crouches low, its bulk pressing toward the viewer. The cyan-rimmed rectangular eye forms give the face a fixed, unblinking quality that sits uneasily against the loose scribbled energy surrounding the body. The wide tooth-filled mouth and raised hand pull in opposite directions — one closed and confrontational, the other open and uncertain. Warm amber tones hold the whole shape together while pink and yellow edge lines keep it restless.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #202 and nnxyz nnotb #204. Where #202 spreads marks across the full canvas in high-contrast multicolor, #203 pulls inward to a compact warm-toned figure. The collector links this work to scrimshaw through its incised-line quality and tonal restraint.

connections.reason: Both works center a wide open-mouthed form with rectangular eye shapes, but #202 spreads a full-spectrum palette across an open field while #203 compresses the same elements into a dense amber figure against a plain ground.

lookingQuestion: What does the difference in line behavior between the tight black outlines on the rectangular eye forms and the loose scribbled lines along the arms suggest about how the figure is held together?
ambiguities: The white marks inside the rectangular eye forms could be screen glare, symbols, or purely abstract marks; no external evidence resolves this.
nnxyz rawblocks #31 shares a brown ground and figure-based composition but differs enough in structure and palette that no strong formal connection was identified; it was not selected.

imageReview.method: Original PNG supplied to separate multimodal drafting and review calls
reviewFindings: All three observations confirmed against the primary image: cyan-and-orange rectangular eye outlines, white interior marks, spiked black head marks, amber/ochre body, pink/yellow/purple edge scribbles, and raised right hand are all visible.
Removed 'suggesting screens or lenses' from observation 2 as it implies subject identity beyond visible form; replaced with neutral phrasing.

Comparison with QmXJvtFj5TUcVDrmZx8v2VPH4RdXR21woKdfscRQz1U21U confirmed against its image: open-mouthed form and rectangular eye shapes are visible in #202, and the palette contrast claim is accurate; connection retained.
